description:
Expertise in webMethods Integration Server, Trading Networks, Designer, My webMethods, EDI X12, EDIFACT, cXML, webServices and Flat Files.
 Experience in developing solutions for large scale EDI/B2B implementations. Good knowledge of web services, XML and defining schemas using DTD/XSD.
 Experience in implementing ALE, IDOC and RFC based interfaces.
 Experience in Unix, Java, J2EE, Oracle and non-relational database.
 8+ years of webMethods experience and 8+ years of middleware experience EDI/FlatFile experience is mandatory. Must be an expert in EDI standards and implementation.
 


 GOOD COMMUNICATION SKILLS 
 
 DURATION: 6+ Months  
 
 INTERVIEW: Telephone / Skype
